messages:
alex: Heads up — new customer org 'NovaHealth' onboarding next week. Need a cross-cloud preflight for account/project setup + quota bumps (GPUs, egress, EIPs, IAM). Target regions: us-west2, europe-west3, ap-southeast1. Planning: reserve 4 A100 equiv per region + 8 spare for burst. Can we run the checklist?
priya: I have a checklist template, will adapt for NovaHealth. Pushing to Confluence and will attach quota request bodies. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/infra/pages/PROV-CHECKLIST :thumbsup:
mike: I can own the AWS side. Do we open a support case or use the marketplace quota request first? My preference is support case + follow-up with marketplace API if needed.
priya: Support case + quota increase form in parallel -> faster. I'll prepare bodies for AWS/GCP/Azure. Also include tags and billing labels.
provision-bot: Created tickets: AWS-A-84721 (https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases/AWS-A-84721), GCP-G-55902, AZ-AR-9933. All tagged with label=pilot_nova.
julia: Tagging rules: billing labels = {"team": "nova", "env": "pilot", "costcenter": "PLG"}. Also enforce org policy to require these labels on project creation. Quick terraform snippet: ```hcl
resource "google_project" "nova_pilot" {
  name = "nova-pilot"
  project_id = "nova-pilot-001"
  labels = {
    team = "nova"
    env  = "pilot"
  }
}
```
alex: Good. Also need KMS + audit logs enabled by default and a compliance pre-check. Priya — can you add KMS key creation and log sink steps to the checklist?
priya: Added KMS step + sample request payloads for quota tickets. For GPUs I'm including: 
```json
{
  "resource": "GPUs (A100)",
  "requested_quota": 12,
  "regions": ["us-west2","europe-west3","ap-southeast1"],
  "justification": "NovaHealth pilot — inference throughput, 3 regions active"
}
```
mike: For networking, ask for VPC egress increase to 10Gbps per region and 50 EIPs/account for initial tests. Also check NAT gateway and carrier limits in ap-southeast1 — ran into throttling there last quarter.
priya: Noted. Adding NAT and EIP counts to GCP/AZ/AWS ticket bodies. Also add a request for higher default IP alias ranges where needed.
alex: Cost guardrails — estimate peak spend ~80k/mo for pilot; we want pre-approved escalation rules or automated caps. Can SRE add alerts for token-per-second or GPU util?
julia: We'll require billing alerts + auto-notify channel. Use tags above so finance can pick up. Also add cost-center mapping in Chargeback dashboard.
priya: Also adding an ops step: run `runit preflight --org nova --regions us-west2,eu-west3,ap-southeast1 --checks quotas,iam,network,kms` before we hand over. Please validate that command for your envs.
mike: Starting AWS case creation now, will paste case id once done.
provision-bot: Calendar invite created: "cross-cloud-provisioning — NovaHealth" Tue 10am PT. Invite: https://calendar.redwood/company/evt/3991.
alex: Perfect. Priya, ping when quota tickets are in and include ticket ids + estimated turnaround so we can schedule capacity ramp. Let's freeze infra changes Friday prior to handoff. :white_check_mark:
